_purpose: Pinned baseline of the authored mandatory-node registry and the session guard (Gate 4N-I28Y).
_trust_limit: This pins the registry and the guard so that a REDUCTION is visible as a diff against an
authored baseline rather than arriving unread. It is not protection against a party who
rewrites the registry, this baseline and the graded command contract coherently in one
change — an authored oracle cannot prove itself. What it does is make each weakening a
separate, visible, reviewable edit in a different file from the one being weakened.
GATE 4N-I28AB. Identity is no longer a name. The registered plugin must be the exact type this
module builds, its source must hash to guard_sha256, its spec origin and loader must match, and
it must carry evidence that its own lifecycle hooks ran. The provenance digest is NOT a secret —
a party with repository read access can recompute it. What it buys is that substituting the
guard now requires changing several separately reviewed, separately pinned files rather than
appending four lines to one conftest.
_why_two_loaders: pytest imports modules under its own assertion-rewriting importer, so the loader class is AssertionRewritingHook inside a pytest session and SourceFileLoader outside one. Both are pytest's or CPython's own importers; the binding that matters is resolved_path plus source_sha256, which are identical either way. Pinning only SourceFileLoader would have made the control fail in the very session it exists to protect.
change_ledger: 4N-I28Y: created. Closes I28X-01 — the graded pytest session did not guarantee that the assertion-control tests were collected and executed. Ten nodes: the three layer-1 executors, the four layer-2 controls (meta contract, collection, registry baseline, helper provenance), the reachability dead-branch pin, and the two layer-3 nodes that protect the guard itself.

4N-I28AB: closes ADV-I28AA-01. Added guard_version, guard_canonical_module, guard_class_qualname and approved_loader_classes so identity is bound to implementation provenance rather than to the plugin name. Mandatory nodes 10 -> 11: the new identity node tests/test_i28ab_guard_identity.py::test_the_registered_guard_is_the_genuine_implementation.

4N-I28AE: closes ACC-I28AC-01. Adds scripts/signalnest_bootstrap.py and scripts/executed_code_provenance.py, pins tests/fixtures/protected-module-set.json, and raises mandatory nodes to 12 with the executed-code provenance node. Identity is now bound to the code objects that actually executed, not to the file on disk, because I28AC proved a substituted module reports the genuine source digest.

change_ledger.what_changed: guard_sha256, bootstrap_sha256, executed_code_provenance_sha256 and protected_module_set_sha256 re-pinned
change_ledger.why: ADV-I28AH-01 required registry_path() to delegate to the new registry_authority module and load_registry() to parse the bytes the authority hashed; ADV-I28AH-02 required the bootstrap to run and re-verify the external-executable trust layer; the protected set grew by the two new verifiers. The mandatory node set itself is UNCHANGED — count and ids are identical.

ADV-I28AJ-01 required the bootstrap to run the derived-inventory layer at configure and re-run it at session finish, and the protected set grew by executable_inventory. The mandatory node set is UNCHANGED.

ADV-I28AL-03 required reverify and pytest_sessionfinish to become critical callables, and executed_code_provenance was added to the protected set because stubbing its verify defeated that fix one level down. Mandatory node set UNCHANGED.
